title: ‘Is that a bribe?’ Chua says of VP Duterte's over P2-M ‘return’

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte’s receipt of over P2 million “return of capital” in the span of four years from GenCorp Industries Inc., despite not having any shares or position in the company, prompted public prosecutor and Manila Rep. Joel Chua to ask if the said amount could be a bribe. Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay, testifying before the Senate impeachment court on Wednesday, said GenCorp has disbursed to Duterte P2,142,369.14 from 2022 to 2025 as “return of capital” from the vice president’s “loose investments,” even as she has no stockholdings or position in the company.
